ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land up to 2 hectares.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank accounts in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Holding Documents, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility: Low-income families identified under SECC 2011 data.
benefits: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card / Family ID, Mobile Number.

eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises needing loans up to ₹10 Lakh.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakh categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-5L), and Tarun (₹5L-10L).
required_documents: ID Proof, Residence Proof, Business Proposal / Plan, Bank Statements, Photographs.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Women & Child Development
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below the age of 10 years.
benefits: High-interest savings account (currently ~8.2%) with EEE tax exemption under Section 80C.
required_documents: Girl Child Birth Certificate, Guardian's Aadhaar & PAN Card, Address Proof.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
eligibility: Street vendors selling goods, snacks, or services in urban areas.
benefits: Working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban & Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation
eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) families without a pucca house.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹2.67 Lakh for home purchase, construction, or renovation.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Bank Account Details, Affidavit of non-ownership of house.

scheme_name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Old Age Pension
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits: Monthly financial pension ranging from ₹200 to ₹500 per month directly credited to bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, BPL Card, Age Proof, Bank Account Details.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftsmen working with hands and tools across 18 specified trades.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate, skill training stipend of ₹500/day, and ₹15,000 toolkit incentive.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Skill / Trade Verification, Mobile Number.

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
eligibility: Residential households owning a house suitable for rooftop solar installation.
benefits: Free electricity up to 300 units per month, with subsidy up to ₹78,000 for 3kW solar systems.
required_documents: Electricity Bill, Property Ownership Proof, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
eligibility: Adult women from BPL / SC / ST / AAY households without an existing LPG connection.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection, first refill free, stove free, plus ₹300 subsidy per refill cylinder.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Woman & Household Members, Ration Card, Bank Passbook.

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
eligibility: Indian youth seeking industry-relevant skill training and certification.
benefits: Free skill training, government certification, placement assistance, and stipend.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Educational Qualification Marksheets, Bank Account Details.

eligibility: SC, ST, or Women entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up new business enterprises.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate (SC/ST), Business Plan, Bank Statements, Address Proof.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits: Comprehensive risk coverage for crops from pre-sowing to post-harvest with low premium rates (1.5% to 2%).
required_documents: Land Record Documents (Khasra/Khatauni), Sowing Certificate, Bank Account Details, Aadhaar Card.

ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, micro & small aquaculture enterprises.
benefits: Financial assistance up to 40% (General) and 60% (SC/ST/Women) for aquaculture equipment, boats & infrastructure.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land/Pond Ownership or Lease Agreement, Bank Account Details.

eligibility: Children studying in Classes I to VIII in Government and Government-aided schools.
benefits: Free hot cooked nutritious meals on all school working days, health checkups, and nutritional supplements.
required_documents: School Admission Record, Student ID, Aadhaar Card.

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
eligibility: Candidates aged 14 and above who have passed 5th/8th/10th/12th or ITI.
benefits: 25% stipend support by Govt up to ₹1,500/month per apprentice during on-the-job training.
required_documents: Educational Certificates, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
eligibility: Girl child in India and her parents/guardians.
benefits: Awareness, educational incentives, school enrolment drives, and financial protection programs.
required_documents: Birth Certificate, School Enrolment Proof, Aadhaar Card.
